blocks.p: The *Health* tab of the *Character* window shows the state of the body and sets up exercise. Figure 23-1 shows the tab as the game draws it: a figure, an *Exercise* button and a list of the body parts with the health of each.

caption: Figure 23-1
The Health tab as the game draws it.

blocks.p: The rest of this chapter describes the tab shown in Figure 23-2.
Figure 23-2 shows the tab with push-ups picked: the figure of the body at the left, overall health and the exercise at the right, and the controls for the exercise along the foot.

caption: Figure 23-2
The Health tab, with push-ups picked.

blocks.p: To exercise, pick the exercise from the *Exercise* pop-up, set the minutes with *-* and *+*, from 10 to 60, and click *Start*. The text under the exercise's name says what it trains.

marks.text: Overall health: a framed bar and a percentage.
This text says what the exercise trains.

sticky.text: The Health tab: the body, overall health and exercise.
